verdict.rationale: Parahelp has some many-item processing. Simulations replay historical tickets against a configuration, the Internal Agent analyzes the last 500-1,000 resolved tickets, and scheduled or triggered automations with auto-approve can act through connections without per-action approval. None of this is documented as a user-directed bulk operation that applies one action to many selected items. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-action capability (e.g., bulk-updating, tagging or closing many tickets at once), documentation of batch scope and limits, and hands-on corroboration.
